name: loading-carousel
title: Loading Carousel
description: A wide image carousel that autoplays through tips, each with a photo, a caption line and a row of thin progress segments you can click.
use: You want to surface several product tips or announcements as photos that advance on their own.
avoid: It autoplays and needs remote images; captions can be missed since slides move on a timer.
a11y: Captions change on a timer without a live region, so screen readers may not hear the new tip. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A wide rounded image fills the top of a dark card, with a slim caption row below it. At the bottom, five hairline progress segments span the width, one filled solid white and the rest dim.
behaves: Slides slide in from the side every few seconds while the active progress segment fills from left to right; clicking a segment jumps to that tip and the caption swaps.
customise: tips takes objects with text, image and optional url; autoplay interval, aspect ratio, navigation, indicators and text position are props.
weight: moderate: Five large remote photos and an autoplay timer; one slide animates at a time.
